  have h11_dvd : 11 ∣ Fintype.card G := by rw [hG]; decide

    | exact exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card h11_prime h11_dvd
    | exact exists_orderOf_eq_prime h11_prime h11_dvd

    exact hx_ne_one h_one.symm
  have h11_tot : 11 ∣ (a ^ 11 - 1).totient := hHerstein 11 ha
  have h_tot_x : 11 ∣ (a ^ orderOf x - 1).totient := by rw [hx]; exact h11_tot
  have h_tot_y : 11 ∣ (a ^ orderOf (x ^ 2) - 1).totient := by rw [h_pow_order]; exact h11_tot
